overview_description.description: Decagon provides an enterprise conversational AI platform that helps businesses automate and manage customer support across channels such as chat, email, and voice. The company’s platform uses configurable agent operating procedures to let teams define workflow logic in natural language while integrating with existing support systems and data sources. Its services include AI agents that can handle inquiry resolution, ticket routing, context-aware responses and actions like refunds or account updates. The platform also supports analytics and tools for monitoring agent performance and iterating on automated support processes.

about_short_description.short_description: Decagon provides a conversational AI platform for automating customer support across multiple channels.

product.name: Decagon AI Agents Platform
product.description: A conversational AI platform that automates customer support and complex customer experience workflows across chat, email, voice, SMS, and API-based surfaces.

product.name: Agent Operating Procedures (AOPs)
product.description: A framework for defining AI-agent behavior with natural-language procedures that can connect to code, business systems, actions, and operational guardrails.

product.name: Omnichannel Support
product.description: AI-powered customer support delivered through chat, email, voice, SMS, and custom interfaces using a centralized agent and shared conversation context.

product.name: Agent Assist
product.description: An AI assistant for human support agents that provides response suggestions, knowledge retrieval, and workflow assistance inside customer service tools.

product.name: CX Insights & Reporting
product.description: Analytics for analyzing customer conversations, identifying recurring themes and anomalies, measuring agent performance, and turning support data into operational insights.

product.name: Testing & QA
product.description: Tools for simulating customer conversations, evaluating AI-agent behavior at scale, and monitoring quality before and after workflow changes.
